analysis.summary: Issue #19 is approximately 80% resolved. Three commits on 2026-03-24 added subagent architecture to issue-resolver (3 agents), issue-analysis (2 agents), and issue-triage (2 agents). The only unmet acceptance criterion is adding a duplicate-detection subagent to issue-creator. init-gitissue was mentioned as a candidate but not in the formal acceptance criteria.
analysis.details:
The subagent architecture was added in commit 1f4838d (2026-03-24) which created agents/ directories with self-contained subagent prompts for issue-analysis (explorer, synthesizer), issue-resolver (researcher, implementer), and issue-triage (history-scanner, dependency-scanner). A follow-up commit 9518210 added the test-writer agent to issue-resolver. Version bumps were applied in ac3fc37.

The pattern uses agents/*.md files (rather than references/subagent-prompts.md as originally proposed) — functionally equivalent, and consistent with the CLAUDE.md architecture description.

Remaining gap: issue-creator has no agents/ directory and no subagent delegation in its SKILL.md. The acceptance criteria specifically call for a duplicate detection subagent enabling parallel execution with template generation. This is a small, well-defined piece of work following the established pattern.

init-gitissue was mentioned in the issue body table but not in the formal acceptance criteria. Its codebase analyzer subagent would be nice-to-have but is not blocking closure.
